actions.label: Down
actions.help: Navigate down in lists, grids and menus

actions.label: Left
actions.help: Navigate left between systems and games

actions.label: Right
actions.help: Navigate right between systems and games

actions.label: A: select / launch game
actions.help: Open gamelists, launch games, confirm in menus (Enter)

actions.label: B: back
actions.help: Go back. The guide only says "Back key"; Backspace is our assumption

actions.label: Start: main menu
actions.help: Open and close the main menu (Escape)

actions.label: Back button: gamelist options
actions.help: Open and close the gamelist options menu (F1)

actions.label: Left shoulder: page up
actions.help: Jump 10 games in gamelists, 6 entries in menus (Page Up)

actions.label: Right shoulder: page down
actions.help: Jump 10 games in gamelists, 6 entries in menus (Page Down)

actions.label: X: media viewer / screensaver
actions.help: Media viewer in a gamelist, screensaver in the systems view (Delete)

actions.label: Y: favourite
actions.help: Mark a game as favourite, if "Enable toggle favorites button" is on (Insert)

actions.label: Random game or system (left stick click)
actions.help: Only if the "Random entry button" option is configured (F2)

actions.label: Random game or system (right stick click)
actions.help: Only if the "Random entry button" option is configured (F3)

actions.label: Quit ES-DE (hold)
actions.help: Alt+F4 closes the application; a long press avoids accidents

profiles.name: Desktop and media
profiles.source: Linux evdev key names; overview and Alt+Tab as configured by GNOME Shell 48 on the test machine

actions.label: On-screen keyboard (open / close)
actions.help: Shows a keyboard on the screen. While it is open the arrows move, OK types the highlighted key and Back closes it; the same button closes it too

actions.label: GNOME overview
actions.help: Super key: shows all windows, pick one with arrows and Enter

actions.label: Switch to the previous window
actions.help: Alt+Tab from one key only toggles the last two windows

actions.label: Full screen (F11)
actions.help: Toggle full screen in many programs

profiles.name: GNOME shell and dock
profiles.source: gsettings on the test machine (GNOME Shell 48.7): org.gnome.shell.keybindings and org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings; dash-to-dock schema and docking.js (hot-keys, shortcut, ctrlAltTabManager.addGroup)

actions.label: Quick settings menu
actions.help: Super+S opens the quick settings menu (network, sound, power) in the top bar

actions.label: Notifications and calendar
actions.help: Super+V (or Super+M) opens the notification list and calendar

actions.label: Focus the dock or top bar (then use the arrows)
actions.help: Ctrl+Alt+Tab opens the system-controls switcher; the dock registers itself there, so it can then be navigated with the arrows. Not verified with a single tap of a remote key: if it does not select, bind it twice or use the dock items below

actions.label: Show the dock with its numbers
actions.help: Super+Q shows the dock with a number on each icon for 2 seconds (it does not give it focus)

actions.label: Dock icon 1
actions.help: Super+1 launches or switches to the first icon of the dock

actions.help: Repeats while held and speeds up
